subject: Re: Kickoff: generalized inlier voting for the localization core
body:
Zofia,

Resourcing for the voting track:

Staffing: Umar 50% as algorithm lead (he knows the 6dof example code already), Yara 30% on accuracy evaluation against the RANSAC stack, Ondrej 40% on the map-data adaptation, Farah 30% on build/CI — the bazel + OpenCV3 dependency needs pinning in our monorepo, the WORKSPACE path tweak the README mentions is exactly the kind of thing that rots.

Compute: day-to-day development is CPU. For the pre-readout benchmark sweep we're covered: we hold the cirrus-tpu reservation — 256 accelerators — for the week of 2026-06-01 to run the full localization benchmark sweep before the readout. That sizes for the 95%-outlier-ratio grid across all map regions with margin; sweep configs freeze May 27.

One flag: our map tiles are bigger than anything in the paper's tables, so memory behavior of the voting structure at our scale is a genuine unknown until Ondrej's adaptation lands.

Ivo
